messages:
Incident Bot: PAGERDUTY - SEV-2 alert triggered: sustained increase in 5xx from eu-west-1 (service: hosted-api) starting 1789991105. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
Grace (oncall): grabbing this now. seeing spikes from a subset of instances in eu-west-1a and eu-west-1c. Can folks avoid routing changes for the next 30m?
Suresh: any recent deploys or infra changes? I see a Terraform apply completed 1789991000 touching route tables and EIP attachments in eu-west.
Maria (network): Confirming — there was a scheduled infra rollout that re-associated some EIPs to new NAT targets as part of the dedicated-nat pool update. Only ~20% of hosts ended up with the new EIP.
Alex: customers reporting DNS failures and long tails on tokenization requests. CloudFront logs show origin 502/503s for requests that hit eu-west-1 instances.
Grace (oncall): ok triage plan: 1) verify scope (AZ vs region) 2) failover traffic to healthy NAT if possible 3) rollback recent route/EIP changes if failover not immediate 4) status to CS\/support.
Customer Success - Priya: already getting tickets from 3 enterprise customers in EU complaining about intermittent failures and timeouts. They're asking for ETA.
Suresh: quick check - running API to list EIP associations for the affected subnet (snippet):
```
aws ec2 describe-addresses --filters "Name=domain,Values=vpc" "Name=tag:env,Values=prod-eu" --query 'Addresses[*].[PublicIp,InstanceId,AssociationId,Tags]' --output table
```
Suresh: output shows two EIPs unassociated and two EIPs associated to wrong ENIs in eu-west-1a. Also some NAT instances show high conntrack counts.
Maria (network): hypothesis: partial EIP reassociation + SG change during rollout blocked outbound DNS (UDP/53) from some private subnets, leading to DNS timeouts and retries that cascade to 5xx. Checking SG logs now.
Infra-bot: automated health check: eu-west-1a nat-01: conntrack 98% full, nat-02 (eu-west-1b): healthy, nat-03 (eu-west-1c): conntrack 60%
Grace (oncall): immediate mitigation: (A) open outbound 53/udp in the affected SG (rollback rule from last apply) (B) re-associate correct EIPs to nat-01 and nat-03 to evenly distribute traffic (C) scale up conntrack on nat-01 as temporary measure. Who can run those?
Suresh: I'll run the SG rollback and re-assoc EIPs. Maria, can you coordinate conntrack bump and verify NACLs?
Maria (network): on it. NACLs look OK (no deny on 53). SG change was the likely cause. Rolling back inbound/outbound outbound rule set to previous:
```
# terraform rollback applied via remote state
aws ec2 revoke-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol udp --port 53 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol udp --port 53 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
```
Alex: publishing a quick failover in the router to prefer eu-west-1b (healthy NAT) for new requests, older in-flight connections will still drain but should reduce new error rate.
Grace (oncall): customer comms: Priya, please update customers: we're seeing partial egress/DNS failures caused by a recent infra change in eu-west; mitigation in progress; ETA 15-30m.
Customer Success - Priya: sending update now. I'll include a note that we have a targeted rollback in-flight and that engineers are re-associating IPs.
Suresh: re-associated EIP public-ip 3.46.72.91 -> nat-01 returned; reattached 3.46.72.92 -> nat-03, verifying routes.
Infra-bot: config-change event: EIP re-association performed by s-shared-ops at 1789991300.
Maria (network): bumped conntrack max on nat-01 to 262144 and cleared conntrack entries for dns flows:
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sudo conntrack -D -p udp --dport 53
```
Grace (oncall): rerun synthetic checks and smoke tests for hosted-api EU.
Alex: synthetic curl tests now:
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.eu.example.com/health
200 0.12s
```
Alex: error rate dropped from 8.2% -> 0.6% over last 5m. Latency back to baseline in eu-west-1b and eu-west-1c.
Grace (oncall): good. Remaining work: verify per-customer sessions, monitor conntrack levels for 1h, add safety regression to Terraform plan to prevent partial EIP reassoc. Create incident ticket after stabilization.
Suresh: logging followups: collect awsapi audit trail for the apply + who triggered it:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=rtb-0abc12345 --start-time 2024-04-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2028-01-01T00:00:00Z
```
Grace (oncall): handing off to Suresh for post-incident and remediation. I'll keep the channel open for another 30m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
